temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria notices Cheryl looking stressed and overwhelmed by stacks of paperwork and planning for the new community outreach project. Cheryl accepts Maria's offer of help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria had no specific prior belief that Cheryl was overwhelmed; she likely viewed Cheryl as a capable colleague managing the outreach project unless shown otherwise.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Maria comes to believe Cheryl is currently stressed and overwhelmed, and that Cheryl welcomes assistance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl is overwhelmed by the project workload and is open to Maria helping her.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concern, empathy, and willingness to help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer and provide help to Cheryl with the paperwork and planning.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria observes Cheryl handling responsibilities better and showing growing confidence. During a staff meeting, Maria suggests Cheryl lead the next phase. Cheryl thanks Maria and says she is ready for the challenge.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After helping Cheryl, Maria believes Cheryl is improving and gaining confidence, but she has not yet firmly concluded that Cheryl should take on a leadership role.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — observing Cheryl's improved handling and confidence leads Maria to believe Cheryl is ready for leadership, and Cheryl's acceptance confirms her willingness.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl is capable, confident, and willing to lead the next phase of the project.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Advocate for Cheryl's leadership and support her in the new role.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria approaches Cheryl privately to check in. Cheryl says she was a bit surprised by the suggestion but appreciates Maria's support and belief in her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl is ready and willing to lead, but she worries that her public suggestion may have felt like overstepping or pressure.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Cheryl's response clarifies that she was surprised but values Maria's support and does not have hard feelings.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl feels supported rather than pressured, and their relationship remains positive.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Initial worry and anxiety turning to relief and reassurance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Ensure Cheryl feels supported and maintain clear, trusting communication.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria proposes that she and Cheryl co-lead the project together. Cheryl responds enthusiastically, says it sounds fantastic, and calls Maria's guidance invaluable.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl appreciated her support and that there are no hard feelings, but she has not yet established whether Cheryl wants to co-lead.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Cheryl enthusiastically agrees to co-leading and values Maria's guidance, showing that the partnership is mutually desired.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl wants to co-lead and sees them as a great team that can support each other.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria and Cheryl have successfully collaborated on several projects, strengthening their partnership. Maria asks about teaming up for more future projects, and Cheryl says she would love that and values working with Maria.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes their collaboration has been fruitful and their partnership has strengthened; she hopes Cheryl will want to continue working together in the future.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Cheryl's response confirms and strengthens Maria's belief that they have strong synergy and mutual interest in future collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria and Cheryl work well together, and Cheryl is eager to team up on more projects in the future.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Team up with Cheryl for more projects in the future.
